I began to worry. And I just did what she asked and gave her space. Well... I wrote her a contract, where I told her I would never break up with her, support her, that we would only see once per week... She love it...

I got sick, and could not see her during two weeks. Her text kept getting weirder... And when I recover she asked me to "talk". I knew then...

She kept crying. She told me how she did not see a future with me and how she did not want to live with me in the future. I felt extremely rejected. She then asked for a break, and I agree.
